About GECE İPTV Player Version Update available: %1$s — see the prompt to install. You\'re on the latest version. Checking… Check for updates What it is A free, open-source IPTV player for Android TV, Fire TV and phones. It\'s a player only — it doesn\'t supply channels; you connect the service you already pay for. Nothing you enter leaves your device except to talk to your own provider. Built in the open GECE İPTV Player is developed openly, with AI doing a large share of the coding under human direction — that\'s stated plainly, not hidden. Because it\'s open source, no single person going away can take it down: anyone can read every line, build it, and carry it on. Support the project GECE İPTV Player is free and always will be — nothing is gated. If it\'s useful and you\'d like to chip in, GitHub Sponsors or a one-off tip keeps the updates coming: new features, fixes and support all come out of spare evenings. Entirely optional, and genuinely appreciated. GitHub Sponsors Donate via PayPal Scan to donate Licence & links Licence Source code Report a bug / request a feature Install page
